items_flat.title_en: OpenAI closes first $11B tranche at $1.25T valuation
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI完成首批110億美元融資，估值1.25兆美元
items_flat.summary_en: Bloomberg and Reuters reported that OpenAI closed roughly $11 billion of a larger round valuing the company at $1.25 trillion, with funds wired as of Friday. The target had been scaled back from earlier $30B+ / $1.4-1.5T ambitions amid market cooling. OpenAI declined to comment.
items_flat.summary_zh: Bloomberg與Reuters報導，OpenAI完成約110億美元的首批融資，公司估值1.25兆美元，資金於週五到位。目標從先前的300億美元以上／1.4-1.5兆美元下修。OpenAI未予置評。
items_flat.analysis_en: This sets a new private-market benchmark just as Anthropic’s IPO is being re-priced lower in the same sell-off, highlighting how quickly AI valuations are adjusting to public-market sentiment and data-center spend concerns.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉在Anthropic IPO同步被下修估值之際，為私有市場訂下新基準，顯示AI估值正快速反映公開市場情緒與資料中心支出疑慮。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic IPO valuation talks center on $1.25-1.75T ahead of Thanksgiving
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic IPO估值討論集中在1.25-1.75兆美元，目標感恩節前上市
items_flat.summary_en: Following its October S-1 filing (ticker ANT), Anthropic is reportedly targeting an $80-100B raise at a $1.25-1.75 trillion valuation before the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday, down from earlier ~$2T discussions. Roadshow timing and exact terms remain fluid.
items_flat.summary_zh: 繼10月提交S-1（代號ANT）後，Anthropic據報目標在美國感恩節前以1.25-1.75兆美元估值募資800-1000億美元，低於先前約2兆美元的討論。路演時程與確切條款仍具彈性。
items_flat.analysis_en: The downward revision mirrors the OpenAI funding adjustment and signals that even the strongest private AI labs are pricing against a cooler public market and post-midterm regulatory uncertainty.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 下修幅度與OpenAI融資調整呼應，顯示即使是最強的私人AI實驗室也必須對更冷靜的公開市場與期中選舉後監管不確定性進行定價。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber for authorized vulnerability research
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber，供授權弱點研究使用
items_flat.summary_en: On November 5, OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized variant of GPT-6 Astra rated Critical for cybersecurity under its Preparedness Framework. It is restricted to Daybreak Red customers for authorized vulnerability discovery, exploit development, and verification. Researchers reported finding 81 new high-severity Firefox bugs and assisting with hundreds of Linux kernel findings.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月5日，OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber，為GPT-6 Astra的專門變體，在其準備框架下被評為網路安全Critical等級。僅限Daybreak Red客戶用於授權的弱點發現、漏洞利用開發與驗證。研究人員報告發現81個新的Firefox高嚴重性漏洞，並協助數百個Linux核心發現。
items_flat.analysis_en: Restricted access and Critical rating reflect the dual-use risks of stronger cyber capabilities; practical value depends on how quickly authorized defenders can leverage it versus potential misuse attempts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 受限存取與Critical評級反映更強網路能力的雙重用途風險；實際價值取決於授權防禦者能多快利用它，以及潛在濫用嘗試的程度。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind AI agents find two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind AI代理發現舊版1024位元RSA兩項弱點
items_flat.summary_en: On November 6, Google DeepMind announced that human-guided AI agents identified two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA: a signature-forgery approach estimated ~1,600× faster for short digests under partial control, and a batch-factoring method that can reduce the cost of each additional key by roughly 30×. Modern 2048-bit and larger keys are unaffected.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月6日，Google DeepMind宣布在人類引導下的AI代理發現舊版1024位元RSA兩項弱點：在部分控制下短摘要的簽章偽造估計可快約1600倍，以及批次分解可將每個額外金鑰成本降低約30倍。現代2048位元以上金鑰不受影響。
items_flat.analysis_en: While limited to retired key sizes and theoretical/sandbox results, the work demonstrates AI agents accelerating cryptanalysis research; practical impact on live systems remains low, but it underscores the need to retire lingering 1024-bit deployments.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 雖僅限於已淘汰的金鑰長度與理論／沙盒結果，此工作展示AI代理加速密碼分析研究；對現行系統的實際影響仍低，但凸顯需淘汰殘留的1024位元部署。

items_flat.title_en: Google makes Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available with 15-second clips
items_flat.title_zh: Google將Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash全面開放，支援15秒影片
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash on November 5, making it generally available on the Gemini API, Gemini for business, and Google Cloud. It supports native 15-second video generation and editing (up from 10s), stronger reference adherence, and pricing of $0.07 per second for 720p (30% lower than Omni 1.1).
items_flat.summary_zh: Google於11月5日宣布Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，並在Gemini API、Gemini for business與Google Cloud全面開放。支援原生15秒影片生成與編輯（由10秒提升）、更強的參考遵循，720p定價每秒0.07美元（較Omni 1.1低30%）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands practical multimodal video tools for business and developer use at lower cost, though audio references remain allowlisted and higher resolutions are upscaled rather than native.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉以較低成本擴展企業與開發者的實用多模態影片工具，但音訊參考仍需白名單，較高解析度為上採樣而非原生。
items_flat.quote: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash introduces native 15-second video creation, multi-turn conversational editing capabilities, and enhanced reference following. We have dropped the price 30% from Gemini Omni 1.1 making it available at $0.07 per second for 720p video.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash引入原生15秒影片創作、多輪對話式編輯能力與強化的參考遵循。我們將價格從Gemini Omni 1.1降低30%，使720p影片以每秒0.07美元提供。

brief_en: Quiet last 12 hours on official channels. Recent high-signal items still circulating: OpenAI closed ~$11B at $1.25T valuation; Anthropic IPO targeting $1.25-1.75T pre-Thanksgiving; DeepMind AI agents found weaknesses in legacy RSA-1024; Google made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash GA with 15s video and lower pricing; OpenAI released restricted GPT-6 Cyber.
brief_zh: 過去12小時官方動態平靜。仍在流傳的高訊號事件：OpenAI完成約110億美元融資、估值1.25兆美元；Anthropic IPO目標1.25-1.75兆美元、感恩節前上市；DeepMind AI代理發現舊版RSA-1024弱點；Google將Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash全面開放（15秒影片、降價）；OpenAI推出受限的GPT-6 Cyber。
